profile.headline: MTS II Software Engineer at Panasonic Avionics Corporation | MS in Computer Science
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at Panasonic Avionics Corporation, I apply my programming knowledge and expertise to ensure the quality and reliability of software products and systems for the aviation industry, specifically pertaining to software used for IFE on Boeing and Airbus models.

I am an experienced developer, knowledgable of Java, JavaScript, Python, Kotlin, C++. I am also experienced with project management, leadership, and front-facing customer interaction on a regular basis.

I am always open to learning more about software engineering, machine learning, AWS, data science, and web development, and I enjoy creating scripting programs for video games in my free time. I endavor to take on new challenges and opportunities to expand my skills and knowledge and contribute to the ever-growing innovation of new technology.

positions.title: Chemical Technician
positions.description:
Laboratory Technician in Research and Development sector.
Conducted research with polymer chemistry, testing physical and chemical properties of paints.
Planned and coordinated experiments to improve product quality.
Regularly managed and led laboratory projects to create prototype samples to present to Technical Directors.
Analysis of chemical and physical properties of paint compounds using various machines and techniques such as Instron, X-Rite, EDS, Profilometry, and Microscopy.
Organized and presented large quantities of experimental data using Excel and Powerpoint on a regular basis to internal management.
Adhered to and carried out laboratory operations in accordance to cGMPs, GLPs, SDS / MSDS, and LIMS.
